description: podman and the docker CLI shim pulling the digest-pinned base images that bin/lint and other projects' toolchains build from. Scoped to Docker Hub's own registry, auth, and blob CDN hosts: a pull from anywhere else still prompts, which is the check that a Dockerfile has not quietly changed where its base comes from. Both CDN spellings are listed because Docker Hub serves blobs from production.cloudflare.docker.com or production.cloudfront.docker.com depending on the client and region — a rule carrying only one of them fails intermittently and looks like a network fault rather than a policy gap.
name: 060-omarchy-allow-podman-registry-pulls
